name: fkst-hosted
description: Unified product version for fkst-hosted (backend + frontend). The Docker build reads this version.
//type: Generated Evolution journeys live under .fkst/evolution/journeys/, whose nearest package.json is THIS one. They are ES modules, so the flag has to be declared here. The repository has no root-level CommonJS for it to affect; backend/ is Rust and frontend/ declares its own.
//devDependencies: Pinned EXACTLY, and to the version frontend/ resolves to. A caret here drifts the runner ahead of frontend/, which pulls a second browser revision and a second @playwright/test instance for the fixtures the journeys import.
